changelog: Added Private Space: an encrypted page for passwords, API keys, 2FA codes and private notes that AI agents can't read. Open it with a master password, fingerprint or PIN, and make encrypted backups

Added the page overview: every page (Chat, IDE, Terminal, Browser, Notes, Files) as a card showing how it looked when you left it and what it is doing now. Tap a card to open it, hold and drag to reorder. Layouts: Large cards, Fit screen or List, and it remembers where you scrolled

A tap on the floating switcher's pill now opens the page overview. In Settings → Appearance you can give the overview its own pill instead (the switcher keeps its icon panel) or turn it off, change the size of both pills, and choose the icon of the collapsed switcher
With the keyboard open, the floating switcher now stays above the chat's input bar instead of covering it, and its pill shows a ripple when you press it
Added home-screen widgets: Chats (your newest chats), Quick actions, and Scripts
Put any chat on your home screen as its own icon: ⋮ on a chat in the sidebar → Add to home screen, or long-press the chat's title. Browser pages, pages of the app and scripts can get an icon too
Long-press AntiGem's app icon to jump straight into your recent chats
Added Settings → Home screen: add widgets and icons, widget colors (AntiGem theme or wallpaper), background opacity, and an option to hide chat names

Home-screen scripts, like Termux:Widget: run your ~/.shortcuts scripts from the Scripts widget, a home-screen icon or "AntiGem script" in your launcher's widget list (Settings → Home screen). Scripts can stay in ~/scripts through a link, get their own icons from ~/.shortcuts/icons, and work in the Ubuntu chroot too
Scripts can also go in the AntiGem icon's long-press menu, and on Android 11+ be Device controls buttons that show when a background script is done

Your AntiGem files now show up in Android's file picker and Files app, so other apps can open and save them. The Ubuntu chroot's home folder shows up too. Turn it on or off in Settings → Files in other apps
Added Settings → Troubleshoot: check the bridge, agents, ports and logs, and share a report

Added Settings → Pets: Gemmy now has 7 friends: Kitsu the nine-tailed fox, Frost the polar bear cub, Beep the robot, Mochi the cat, Cinder the baby dragon, Mist the ghost and Lotl the axolotl. Each has its own reactions, a signature move and a favourite treat
Added the Discord theme: Discord's dark look with deep greys and a blurple accent. It's now the default dark theme, followed by Obsidian and Midnight Aurora (a dark theme you already picked stays)
Added Settings → Language: make your own language for the app, edit its texts, and import, export or share language files. Switching languages changes the app at once, no restart

Added Get more languages in Settings → Language: download languages made by people who use AntiGem from the AntiGem Languages repository on GitHub. They show who made them and get updates right in the app. The app itself now ships only English
Downloaded languages can't be edited, so an update never overwrites your changes: duplicate one to change it
Name & details of your own language lists everyone who made it (with GitHub usernames), plus a description and a variant like Formal
Added Send to the community in a language's ⋮ menu: share a language you made so everyone can download it
AI agents can translate the app for you with the new Language MCP server (in each agent's MCP settings), and list and download community languages; you watch the app change while they work

Added a sessions drawer to the terminal, like Termux: swipe right from the left edge to switch, rename or close sessions (each has Rename and Close buttons), show the keyboard, start a new session or open terminal settings. With gesture navigation, choose where on the left edge the swipe works (top, middle or bottom)
The terminal's floating session pill is now off by default (turn it on in Settings → Terminal)

Terminal: change the extra keys above the keyboard (more rows, any keys, a ☰ key for the sessions menu, swipe-up keys, macros) and the CTRL shortcuts for sessions in Settings → Terminal → Extra keys and shortcuts. Your Termux settings can be imported
Swipe the terminal's extra-keys bar sideways for a text box where any keyboard works fully (Bangla/Japanese drafts, suggestions, voice typing)
The terminal keyboard now shows its toolbar and clipboard. For keyboards that misbehave there, turn on Character-Based Input in Settings → Terminal
Pasting into the terminal from the keyboard is now one quick paste instead of typing every character, and pasted lines aren't run one by one
Renaming a tmux session also renames its tmux window, so the name stays after reconnecting
With the Termux-style terminal icon, Recents now shows the terminal with the Termux icon and name
Fixed words lost when typing in the terminal with phonetic or Japanese keyboards, Bangla/Hindi marks shown as <09cd> in zsh, and fast typing getting scrambled in SSH/tmux terminals
Fixed the terminal keyboard sometimes not opening on tap (quick double taps, older Android); the sessions drawer also has a button to show it
Fixed SSH terminals skipping the server's host key check and your saved SSH key when opening or closing remote tmux windows
Fixed termux-tts-speak staying silent on its first text
Fixed crashes when the terminal starts on Android 8 and when opening a new terminal session
Added on/off switches for each skill, MCP server and plugin of Antigravity, Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode: turn one off without removing it
Antigravity: when a model's weekly limit is used up, the chat shows "7d 0%" instead of the 5-hour share, which could still read 100% while the model can't run
Added a Switch account button for Antigravity in the accounts dialog (tap your profile): save, switch, add or delete accounts without opening Settings
Antigravity subagent chats now sit under the chat that started them, and opening a chat no longer unfolds its subagents
Claude Code subagents can now be renamed, deleted and exported too
Antigravity cloud agents: fixed attachments (files up to 20 MB) and the chat list
Added provider chips to the Claude Code and OpenCode model pickers, to find a provider's models in one tap
"Clauding" now shows only in Claude Code chats while the agent works
Signing out of Antigravity, Claude Code or Codex now asks you to confirm first
Jarvis: approve a command by voice ("yes, run it"), see everything Jarvis approved for you, and it asks before switching Claude Code to a mode that asks you less
Fixed Claude Code sometimes losing the last reply or error line at the end of a turn
Fixed exporting and sharing OpenCode chats from the chat list ("conversation not found")
Fixed undoing the first message of an Antigravity chat leaving the input box empty, and attachments going missing when editing an Antigravity message
Fixed Antigravity sometimes failing to start with "text file busy"
Fixed huge agent error messages crashing the chat
Web pages in chat can now be sites made of several files (HTML, CSS, JS) or a page saved on the phone, and the new /playground command makes live HTML/CSS/JS pages
Long chats full of images use much less memory: pictures and voice notes are kept as files instead of in memory

Chats open faster and stay smooth: the message list is built in the background, scrolling no longer redraws the whole screen, and home-screen widgets no longer slow the chat while an agent is answering
The chat keeps following the agent when it asks for approval
Fixed voice messages in chat sometimes playing the wrong recording
The IDE can show Markdown files as a formatted preview and preview HTML files, and a path bar shows the open file's full path with its folders
Added Go to Line in the IDE's editor menu

The IDE's file tree now reads a folder only when you open it, so big projects open fast and use much less memory, and it updates by itself while the sidebar is open: new, deleted and renamed files show up within a few seconds

Fixed the phone freezing when opening a very big file in the IDE. Files too big for it (text over 5 MB, pictures over 15 MB) are refused before anything is downloaded, with a Share button to open them in another app
The IDE now asks before opening a file that isn't text, before downloading it
The file open in the IDE now reloads only when it changed on disk, instead of being downloaded again every few seconds
Tapping another file while one is still opening in the IDE now cancels the first one, and the file being opened shows a spinner
Saving a file in the IDE now keeps its permissions (scripts stay executable), and moving a folder into its parent folder no longer deletes it
Loading spinners in the IDE's file tree and when opening the terminal now show only when loading is actually slow, instead of flashing every time
Fixed a strip of a different color next to the IDE's sidebar and behind the status bar
Fixed Notes not scrolling to the cursor when you move it with the keyboard's arrow keys (Gboard, Ridmik), and note text no longer hides behind the keyboard
AntiGem now checks free storage before installing the Linux environment, Android dev tools, REA, the desktop or an app update, and tells you how much to free up instead of failing halfway
Running out of storage during an install now says so clearly, and the half-finished install is removed so it doesn't keep the phone full
Fixed AntiGem crashing when the phone's storage is full
Commands and scripts now show a clear message when the local environment isn't installed yet, instead of failing

More security: plugins ask before every install and update, other apps can no longer make AntiGem open its private files, and home-screen shortcuts and widgets are signed (Settings → Home screen → Link key)
Plugins in /sdcard/antiGem/extensions no longer load, because any app could put code there: install them again in Settings → Plugins
Backups without "include secrets" now leave out SSH keys, API keys, logins and shell histories, and crash reports hide paths, addresses and tokens before you see or send them
Added a Phone tools key in Settings → Where agents run: make a new key if you think yours leaked. On servers, the bridge token no longer shows in the process list
Wireless debugging that AntiGem turned on now turns itself off after 10 idle minutes, and a changed SSH host key now shows the new key's fingerprint
Better TalkBack and keyboard support across the app: labelled buttons and keys, show/hide password buttons, and hidden pages are no longer read out

TalkBack in chat: it says when a reply is finished, when the agent needs your approval or asks a question; your prompts are headings so you can jump between them; scrolling up stops following the agent; numbered and checklist items are read as one item each; choices and tabs say which one is selected; sign-in, setup and more screens read clearly
Better Android 7 support: Java file features missing on Android 7 now come with the app
Fixed the app icon on Android 7: it showed as a big dark square, now it's a rounded icon the same size as other apps
Fixed connection (SSL) errors and a crash on Android 7 and 7.1
Fixed the app showing its bridge offline on mobile data with a carrier proxy
Fixed a crash when changing the app's language while an agent was working
Fixed crashes when coming back to the app, in app previews, in the chat list when the same chat showed up twice, in half-open bottom sheets, and when dragging something onto a page in the browser
Settings: removed the On/Off badges next to switches (the switch already shows it), and long names no longer push the switch off the screen
Beta updates now turn off by themselves once the next stable version is installed; turn them on again in Settings → Updates

Added App Text Size in Settings → Appearance: make the app's own text (settings, lists, menus, dialogs) smaller or bigger without changing other apps. Chat messages keep their own size from Chat Text Scaling. Apply restarts the screen once
The IDE's code editor now remembers your pinch zoom: it stays when you switch files or pages, and after restarting the app
